description: tangent-cylinders-cut's tool moved into the target by a tolerance (1e-7), or turned about the contact's middle so its ends move two tolerances in and out. The walls cross in two rulings 6.3e-4 apart, or a skew section beside the contact, around a sliver a tolerance thick. Arris fails: a section edge of the target's cap ends at a node nothing else reaches (Fault::Split, Dangling). The desired result is a clean cut: the target within the tolerance, the target less the sliver beyond. Open CASCADE imprints the two rulings on the wall (4/6/4/4, and 4/5/3/3 at the turn) where Arris keeps the wall whole at the contact (tangent-cylinders-cut, 2/3/3/3); the step that fixes this states Arris's counts per variant (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 1, the band survey)
